_dr_note: CONTRACT ONLY — this is the intended n8n workflow shape for the premium Veo 3.1 Fast per-scene executor. It is NOT deployed and NOT active on the n8n instance. No credential values appear here (references only). It MUST NOT be activated until the founder authorizes a bounded generation run; the DB gate fn_video_generation_authorization_state must return dispatch_allowed=true (provider enabled + founder authorization + within the per-run cap) before any paid Veo call is made.
name: Strateloq - Veo Scene Executor (CONTRACT, inactive)
description: Premium hybrid per-scene generative executor. For ONE planned shot: receives {scene_id, video_job_id, mode, prompt, aspect_ratio, duration_s, seed_image_ref}. For plate/no-product scenes (mode=TEXT_TO_VIDEO) NO product seed is sent — the prompt explicitly excludes the product so Veo renders only the environment plate. For the reference-motion mode (mode=IMAGE_TO_VIDEO) the authoritative Product Card is the first-frame seed; identity is NOT guaranteed, so the scene stays IDENTITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED. Calls the Gemini API predictLongRunning on the EXISTING Gemini credential (no new account), polls the operation, downloads the clip, uploads it to the private pulse-generated-media bucket, then calls the DB completion function with identity_state=IDENTITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED for a generated clip.

nodes.name: Scene Executor Webhook
nodes.notes: Body: {scene_id, video_job_id, mode, prompt, aspect_ratio:'9:16', duration_s, seed_image_ref|null}. The edge function video-scene-execute only reaches this AFTER the DB cost/authorization gate returns dispatch_allowed=true.

nodes.name: Veo predictLongRunning (dispatch)

googlePalmApi.name: Gemini account (EXISTING; reference only — no key value stored here)

nodes.notes: For mode=IMAGE_TO_VIDEO (reference-motion only), the instance also carries the Product Card as the seed image; for plate/no-product scenes NO image is sent. Veo 3.1 Fast = cheapest premium tier. Returns a long-running operation name.

nodes.name: Poll Operation Until Done
nodes.notes: Poll GET on the returned operation name until done:true, then read the generated clip URI. (Wait/IF loop; omitted in the contract shape.)

nodes.name: Upload Clip to pulse-generated-media
nodes.notes: Download the clip bytes and upload to the PRIVATE pulse-generated-media Supabase Storage bucket; keep it private (generated content, identity-review-required).

nodes.name: Call DB scene-complete
nodes.notes: POST to the DB scene-completion RPC with {scene_id, video_job_id, provider_operation_id, storage_ref, mime, width, height, duration, cost, currency}. The completion function records the scene asset with identity_state=IDENTITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED — a generated clip is NEVER auto-launch-safe. Identity validation (fn_video_identity_validate_decision) runs next.
